g.text: Stream independent BPM analysis while listening
If the session context changes: latch silently, keep listening;
halt after the manual Stop, discard the result, restart required
Indicate Busy during analysis; reject Start without queuing.
Start during sending cancels the delivery; the result is lost
Aggregate retained valid estimates and interval
Latch BPM fault; no numeric value
Device id / server profile image ready?
Retry up to 3 times within the delivery deadline
If still failing: latch delivery fault
No send attempt or Wi-Fi error
Streaming BPM requires no saved raw-session audio.
